name: Molniya + Tundra (HEO comms + early warning)
agency: Roscosmos / US Space Force / Sirius XM
manufacturer: NPO Lavochkin / ISS Reshetnev / Loral / Northrop Grumman
best_known_for: High-eccentricity orbits at 63.4° critical inclination — Molniya (12-hour, ~600 × 40,000 km) for Russian high-latitude comms + Oko/Meridian; Tundra (24-hour, ~25,000 × 35,786 km) for Sirius XM + SBIRS-HEO early warning
credit: Russian Molniya satellites operational since 1965 (Molniya 1A); Tundra used by Sirius XM (since 2000) + US SBIRS-HEO. Both exploit J2 critical-inclination apsidal lock.
